sn35.121:27.1: “Anything included in feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness that arises dependent on tongue contact: is that permanent or impermanent?”
sn35.121:29.1: “But if it’s impermanent, is it suffering or happiness?”
sn35.121:31.1: “But if it’s impermanent, suffering, and perishable, is it fit to be regarded thus:
sn35.121:31.2: ‘This is mine, I am this, this is my self’?”
